subject: Lincoln Lion Roar - Weekly Newsletter - May 15, 2026
text_body:
LINCOLN LION ROAR
Weekly Newsletter - May 15, 2026

Dear Lincoln Families,

We've had another wonderful week at Lincoln Elementary! Here's what's happening:

PRINCIPAL'S CORNER
Thank you to all the families who joined us for our Spring Open House last night. It was wonderful to see so many of you celebrating our students' hard work. A special shout-out to our 5th grade scientists who presented their ecology projects!

PTA UPDATE
- Spring Book Fair: May 19-23 in the Library. Volunteers still needed for Wednesday and Thursday afternoon slots.
- PTA Meeting: Tuesday, May 20 at 6:30 PM in the Staff Room. Agenda includes budget planning for next year and discussion of playground improvements.
- Restaurant Night Fundraiser: Thursday, May 22 at Round Table Pizza on El Camino. Mention Lincoln Elementary and 20% of your bill goes to our school!

LUNCH MENU - Week of May 19
Monday: Chicken nuggets, mashed potatoes, green beans
Tuesday: Bean & cheese burrito, Spanish rice, corn
Wednesday: Macaroni & cheese, steamed broccoli, fruit cup
Thursday: Beef hot dog, baked beans, carrot sticks
Friday: Pepperoni pizza, Caesar salad, apple slices

UPCOMING DATES
- May 20: PTA Meeting, 6:30 PM
- May 22: Restaurant Night at Round Table Pizza
- May 26: No School - Memorial Day
- May 30: 5th Grade Track & Field Day
- June 6: 2nd Grade Art Show, 5:00 PM
- June 12: Last Day of School - Minimum Day

Have a great weekend!

Lincoln Elementary School
1250 Lincoln Avenue
Palo Alto, CA 94301
